A_agent_runs.card:
Decision card · ord-001
Outcome: No PA · safe to act
Why: Patient meets Medicare LCD coverage criteria for non-dialysis CKD ESA therapy:
- Diagnosis includes D63.1 (anemia of CKD) and N18.32 (CKD stage 3b) (billing article supports dual-diagnosis requirement for non-dialysis ESA codes) — see A58982, p.10 and p.22.
- Hemoglobin 9.4 g/dL is below the <10 g/dL threshold required to initiate ESA for CKD not on dialysis — see L39237, p.7.
- eGFR 38 mL/min/1.73 m2 (<45) and recent creatinine within the past month satisfy the GFR/creatinine and timing requirements — see L39237, p.7; A58982, p.10.
Next step: Proceed with the order; submit claim with required diagnosis codes (D63.1 plus N18.32), appropriate ESA HCPCS (J0885) and any required modifiers per billing guidance.
Source: LCD L39237 Erythropoiesis Stimulating Agents (Palmetto GBA), pages 6–7; Billing and Coding Article A58982, pages 10 and 21–22.

Decision card · ord-001
Outcome: No PA · safe to act
Why: Medicare Part B coverage policy (A58982 / L39237) allows epoetin alfa (J0885) for CKD not on dialysis when documentation requirements are met (diagnosis of D63.1 plus an applicable CKD code such as N18.32, pre-initiation Hb < 10 g/dL, GFR/creatinine supporting CKD stage, and required iron studies); the patient’s facts meet these criteria (D63.1 and N18.32, Hgb 9.4, eGFR 38, not on dialysis).
Next step: Proceed with administration/billing under Original Medicare; include required diagnosis codes and modifiers (EC and appropriate JA/JB), and retain documentation (serum creatinine/GFR, pre-initiation Hb, iron studies, dose plan) to support medical necessity.
Source: Billing and Coding Article A58982 (Erythropoiesis Stimulating Agents for L39237), pages 10, 11, 13.

Decision card · ord-001
Outcome: No PA · safe to act
Why: Patient meets Medicare LCD coverage criteria for ESA in CKD not on dialysis — has anemia of CKD (D63.1 present), an appropriate CKD stage code (N18.32), an eGFR <45 (38) and hemoglobin 9.4 g/dL; required labs (creatinine/GFR) are documented and the ESA code J0885 is listed for non‑ESRD use in the LCD.
Next step: Proceed with treatment and billing; include required documentation and modifiers (EC and appropriate JA/JB), and submit serum creatinine/GFR and ferritin/TSAT as part of the medical record per LCD.
Source: Billing and Coding Article A58982 (for LCD L39237) — Required Documentation and CKD not on dialysis criteria, pages 10 and 21.

Decision card · ord-001
Outcome: No PA · safe to act
Why: Medicare LCD/Article (L39237 / A58982) set coverage criteria for non‑ESRD ESA use rather than a prior authorization process; the required documentation elements (diagnosis D63.1, CKD diagnosis N18.32, serum creatinine/GFR, and low Hb) are present for this order.
Next step: Proceed with the service per Medicare coverage rules and include the required documentation (serum creatinine/GFR, diagnosis codes D63.1 and N18.32, Hb result) on the claim; if the payer returns the claim, respond with the cited documentation.
Source: Billing & Coding Article A58982 (for LCD L39237), pages 6 (modifiers/denial reasons) and 10 (required documentation, GFR threshold for CKD non‑dialysis) and page 17 (J0885 listed as non‑ESRD code). Also LCD L34356 page 11 (Hb/GFR guidance).

Decision card · ord-001
Outcome: No PA · safe to act
Why: Patient meets Medicare Local Coverage Determination (L39237) coverage criteria for ESA use in CKD not on dialysis: Hb 9.4 g/dL (<10) and eGFR 38 mL/min/1.73m2 (<45) with recent creatinine within the past month (meets initiation criteria) (LCD L39237, pp. 7-8).
Why: The related Medicare billing & coding article (A58982) lists J0885 in the non‑ESRD/CKD-not-on-dialysis group and specifies required documentation elements (diagnosis D63.1 plus appropriate CKD code, recent creatinine/GFR, Hb <10) and required modifiers — this is coverage guidance rather than a separate payer prior-authorization requirement for Original Medicare (A58982, pp. 10, 17).
Next step: Proceed with administration/claim under Original Medicare ensuring documentation on chart supports: D63.1 and CKD code (N18.32), recent creatinine/GFR (within 1 month), pre-initiation Hb, and apply required claim modifiers per billing article; retain lab and clinical documentation in case MAC requests medical records.
Source: LCD L39237 “Erythropoiesis Stimulating Agents” (Palmetto GBA), pp. 7-8 (coverage criteria for CKD not on dialysis; lab and timing requirements); Billing & Coding Article A58982, pp. 10 and 17 (J0885 listed for non-ESRD use; required documentation and modifier guidance).

A_agent_runs.card:
Decision card · ord-002
Outcome: Other gate (coverage criteria not met) · not safe to act
Why: Patient has CKD stage 3a (N18.31) with eGFR 52 mL/min/1.73 m2, which is above the GFR threshold cited to support ESA use in CKD-not-on-dialysis; the policy cites GFR <45 mL/min/1.73 m2 as a reasonable threshold for ESA coverage in CKD not on dialysis. (Hgb 9.4 meets low-Hb requirement, but the GFR/stage requirement is not met.)
Next step: Deny or hold for medical necessity — request clinical justification and supporting documentation if provider believes ESA is medically necessary despite eGFR >45 (e.g., extraordinary transfusion dependence or other documented reasons meeting Medicare exceptional-case expectations).
Source: Billing & Coding Article A58982, "Erythropoiesis Stimulating Agents (for L39237)", page 10 (GFR threshold and required diagnosis codes); LCD L39237 / related ESA coverage language cited in A58982 (coverage guidance) — Article A58982 page 5–10.

Decision card · ord-002
Outcome: Other gate (coverage criteria not met) · not safe to act
Why: Patient has CKD not on dialysis with diagnosis N18.31 (CKD stage 3a) and eGFR 52; CMS guidance requires D63.1 plus a CKD diagnosis of N18.32, N18.4, N18.5 (or specified hypertensive/CKD codes) or GFR <45 to support ESA coverage for CKD not on dialysis (stage IIIa explicitly does not meet the GFR/diagnosis requirements). See required diagnosis/GFR criteria and note that stage I/II/IIIa do not meet coverage on pages 10–11.
Next step: Staff should either provide documentation of an alternative covered diagnosis or clinical exception (e.g., transfusion dependence or other NCD-allowed indication) that meets CMS coverage, or cancel/modify the order; if an exception is claimed, collect supporting records (labs, transfusion history, iron studies) and submit for review.
Source: Billing & Coding Article A58982, “Erythropoiesis Stimulating Agents (for L39237)”, pages 10–11 (required diagnoses/GFR and note that stage I/II/IIIa CKD do not meet coverage).

Decision card · ord-002
Outcome: Other gate (coverage criteria not met) · not safe to act
Why: Patient meets the Hb criterion (pre-initiation Hb < 10 g/dL) but does not meet the CKD GFR/stage requirement for ESA use in CKD not on dialysis — the guidance identifies a GFR < 45 mL/min/1.73 m2 as a reasonable threshold and explicitly notes patients with stage I, II and IIIa CKD do not meet the GFR requirements for coverage with the listed ICD-10 code combinations. The patient’s eGFR is 52 (CKD stage 3a), so coverage criteria are not met.
Next step: Staff should either (a) withhold ESA administration under Medicare coverage unless further documentation justifies coverage (for example documentation of other covered indication or rescue dialysis status), or (b) obtain additional clinical justification/records that would support an exception (e.g., evidence of symptomatic transfusion dependence or other diagnosis codes permitted by the ESA coverage guidance) and then re-evaluate coverage/submit for review.
Source: Billing and Coding Article A58982, “Erythropoiesis Stimulating Agents (ESA) (for L39237)”, pages 10–11 — statements re: GFR < 45 mL/min/1.73 m2 threshold, note that stage I/II/IIIa CKD do not meet GFR requirements, and required documentation elements including pre-initiation Hb < 10 g/dL (pages 10–11).

Decision card · ord-002
Outcome: Other gate (coverage criteria not met) · not safe to act
Why: Patient does not meet Medicare LCD/article coverage criteria for ESA in non‑dialysis CKD:
- The billing & coding article (A58982) states a GFR <45 mL/min/1.73 m2 is a reasonable threshold to support ESA administration for CKD not on dialysis; required documentation includes serum creatinine and/or GFR and specific CKD diagnosis codes (e.g., N18.32, N18.4, N18.5) billed with J0885 for non‑ESRD use (A58982, p. 10). (Patient eGFR = 52, diagnosis coded N18.31.) Source: Billing and Coding Article A58982, page 10.
- The Palmetto LCD L39237 governs ESA coverage in Tennessee (Palmetto jurisdiction includes Tennessee), so the A58982 requirements apply to this patient under Original Medicare in TN. Source: LCD L39237 (jurisdiction list and document effective/revision info), pages 1–3.

Next step: Confirm whether clinical justification can be documented to meet coverage criteria (for example, an alternative ICD‑10 code indicating more advanced CKD or documentation showing GFR <45 or other covered indication). Staff should obtain updated labs/diagnoses or consider denial/appeal/alternative therapy per Medicare guidance.
Source: LCD L39237, pages 1–3; Article A58982, page 10.

Decision card · ord-002
Outcome: No PA · safe to act
Why: Medicare Part B coverage article A58982 lists J0885 (epoetin alfa, non-ESRD use) as a covered code for CKD patients not on dialysis and specifies clinical documentation required (serum creatinine/GFR, diagnosis of symptomatic anemia of CKD such as D63.1 plus appropriate CKD diagnosis) rather than a prior authorization requirement. (A58982 pp. 9-10, 17)
Next step: Proceed with administration/claim submission ensuring required documentation is on the chart and claim (serum creatinine/GFR, diagnosis codes including D63.1 and appropriate CKD code, pre-initiation Hb, iron studies, dose/frequency). If the MAC requests records, provide the documented criteria per A58982.
Source: Billing and Coding Article A58982, “Erythropoiesis Stimulating Agents (for L39237)”, pages 9-10 and 17.

A_agent_runs.card:
Decision card · ord-003
Outcome: Other gate (coverage criteria not met) · not safe to act
Why: CMS billing/coding guidance for ESA (A58982 / L39237) requires CKD not on dialysis patients to have supporting GFR/creatinine consistent with coverage (guidance cites a GFR < 45 mL/min/1.73 m2 as a reasonable threshold), and Maria’s eGFR is 52 (does not meet the stated GFR threshold).
Next step: Staff should either (a) obtain/submit additional clinical justification or documentation that demonstrates the patient meets an allowable coverage category (e.g., alternative covered diagnosis or evidence of rescue dialysis/other exception), or (b) decline to bill Medicare for J0885 and consider alternative management. If additional facts exist (outside records, recent creatinine/GFR showing <45, or other qualifying diagnosis), submit those with the claim for reconsideration.
Source: Billing and Coding Article A58982 (for LCD L39237), pages 10–11 — required documentation and GFR threshold language; dosing and Hb pre-initiation requirement (page 10–11).

Decision card · ord-003
Outcome: Other gate (coverage criteria not met) · not safe to act
Why: Patient has CKD not on dialysis (order J0885) but current GFR/eGFR (52 mL/min/1.73 m2) is above the guideline threshold cited (policy cites GFR <45 mL/min/1.73 m2 as a reasonable threshold to support ESA for CKD non-dialysis) (mcd-article-a58982, p.10).
Why: The policy requires specific CKD diagnosis codes billed with J0885 for CKD non-dialysis ESA use (D63.1 plus one of I12.0, I13.11, I13.2, N18.32, N18.4, or N18.5); the patient’s CKD code is N18.31 (not listed) so required diagnosis-code pairing is not met (mcd-article-a58982, p.10).
Why: Non-ESRD ESA claims must include the EC modifier and JA/JB modifiers as required by Medicare billing policy; the open order does not show these modifiers (mcd-article-a58982, p.6 & p.10).
Next step: Staff should either: (1) deny/hold the request per Medicare coverage criteria, or (2) request corrected diagnosis coding (one of the listed CKD codes) and/or documentation justifying ESA use despite eGFR >45 (e.g., compelling clinical justification or transfusion dependence), and ensure required modifiers (EC and JA/JB) are applied before resubmission.
Source: Billing and Coding Article A58982, “Erythropoiesis Stimulating Agents (for L39237)” — p.6 (modifier and non-ESRD/ESRD code guidance), p.10 (GFR threshold, required documentation and required diagnosis codes), p.17 (HCPCS grouping for J0885).

Decision card · ord-003
Outcome: Other gate (coverage criteria not met) · not safe to act
Why: The LCD L39237 covers ESAs for CKD only for stages IIIb, IV and V (and ESRD); the patient’s eGFR is 52 (CKD stage 3a), so the non-ESRD CKD indication in the record does not meet the covered-stage criteria (L39237, Coverage Indications, pages 5-6).
Next step: Do not authorize. Staff should notify ordering clinician that Medicare coverage is not supported for J0885 for CKD stage 3a (eGFR 52); if there is a rare, well-documented clinical justification (e.g., severe symptomatic comorbidity requiring higher Hb) or an alternative covered indication (e.g., chemotherapy-related anemia, ESRD), submit that documentation for reconsideration/appeal.
Source: LCD L39237 Erythropoiesis Stimulating Agents, Coverage Indications, Limitations and/or Medical Necessity (pages 5-6).

Decision card · ord-003
Outcome: Other gate (coverage criteria not met) · not safe to act
Why: Patient has CKD not on dialysis and meets anemia Hb criterion (Hgb 9.4) but documentation/guidance requires supporting CKD stage and reduced GFR (guidance cites a GFR <45 mL/min/1.73 m2 as a reasonable threshold to support ESA use for CKD not on dialysis); the patient’s eGFR is 52 (above the cited threshold) and the LCD/article requires specific CKD diagnosis coding and modifiers (EC + JA/JB) and serum creatinine/GFR documentation.
Next step: Staff should (1) confirm whether additional supporting diagnoses (e.g., N18.32, N18.4, N18.5 or other listed codes) or clinical justification exist to support ESA use despite eGFR 52; (2) obtain and attach serum creatinine/GFR documentation and iron studies per policy; (3) add required HCPCS modifiers (EC and JA/JB where applicable) or consider alternative management if criteria cannot be met before re-submission.
Source: Billing and Coding Article A58982 (Erythropoiesis Stimulating Agents for LCD L39237), pages 10 and 17 — required documentation, GFR threshold guidance, code groupings and modifier requirements.

Decision card · ord-003
Outcome: Other gate (coverage criteria not met) · not safe to act
Why: The Medicare billing article (A58982) for ESAs requires, for CKD patients not on dialysis, either CKD diagnosis codes listed (e.g., N18.32, N18.4, N18.5) and/or GFR typically <45 mL/min/1.73 m2 to support ESA use; the patient’s record shows N18.31 (CKD stage 3a) and eGFR 52 (above the <45 threshold), so the coverage criteria in the MAC guidance are not met.
Next step: Staff should either (a) provide documentation of an allowable diagnosis/indication included in the MAC policy (e.g., CKD stage/diagnosis that the article lists or other covered indication) or evidence that eGFR <45 (or other qualifying circumstance), then resubmit; or (b) pursue alternative treatment options or a medical review request if clinical justification differs from the listed criteria.
Source: Billing and Coding Article A58982 (for LCD L39237), pages 9–10 and 17 (Required documentation and CKD non-dialysis criteria; code groupings).

Required dual diagnoses for CKD not on dialysis (D63.1 and a CKD stage code such as N18.32) are present, and eGFR 38 (GFR <45) meets the GFR threshold to consider ESA therapy

Key coverage documentation is missing: current hemoglobin/hematocrit value showing symptomatic anemia and iron studies (TSAT >=20% and ferritin >=100 ng/mL) and documentation of evaluation/treatment of other causes of anemia
Billing requirements (EC and route modifiers JA/JB and required diagnosis codes) must also be met for payment
